records.question: Jack is making barbecue sauce. He uses 3 cups of ketchup, 1 cup of vinegar and 1 cup of honey. If each burger takes 1/4 cup of sauce and each pulled pork sandwich takes 1/6 cup, how many burgers can Jack make if he makes 18 pulled pork sandwiches?
records.response:
Jack makes 18 * 1/6 = 3 cups of pulled pork sauce.
Jack has 3 + 3 = 6 cups of barbecue sauce.
He can make 6 / 1/4 = 6 * 4 = 24 burgers.
